step1_analysis.circuit_type: Differential Inductive Load / LC Tank Inductors
step1_analysis.description: A pair of inductors connected to VDD, typically used as a differential inductive load for an RF amplifier, mixer, or as part of an LC tank in a VCO.

paper_reference.title: A 900-MHz Dual-Conversion Low-IF GSM Receiver in 0.35-m CMOS

Inductance.description: The inductance value of the load inductors.

sky130_expected.calculation: Directly from the netlist component values.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The netlist explicitly defines L1 and L2 as 16.5nH.

Impedance_at_900MHz.description: The AC impedance magnitude of the inductor at the 900 MHz operating frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using the ideal inductor impedance formula at the target RF frequency of 900 MHz mentioned in the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the AC impedance and extracts the inductance of the differential inductors at 900 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Inductive Load Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
L1 VDD OUTR 16.5nH
L2 VDD OUTL 16.5nH

* DC Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* AC Current Sources for Impedance Measurement
* Injecting 1A AC current into the nodes to measure impedance directly as voltage
I1 0 OUTR DC 0 AC 1
I2 0 OUTL DC 0 AC 1

* Analysis
.ac dec 100 100MEG 10G

.control
  run
  
  * Calculate impedance magnitude (V = I*Z, since I=1A, mag(V) = mag(Z))
  let Z_mag_R = mag(v(OUTR))
  let Z_mag_L = mag(v(OUTL))
  
  * Measure impedance at 900 MHz
  meas ac Z_900M_R find Z_mag_R at=900MEG
  meas ac Z_900M_L find Z_mag_L at=900MEG
  
  * Extract inductance L = Z / (2 * pi * f)
  let L_est_R = Z_mag_R / (2 * 3.1415926535 * frequency)
  let L_est_L = Z_mag_L / (2 * 3.1415926535 * frequency)
  
  * Measure extracted inductance at 900 MHz
  meas ac L_900M_R find L_est_R at=900MEG
  meas ac L_900M_L find L_est_L at=900MEG
  
  print Z_900M_R Z_900M_L L_900M_R L_900M_L
  quit
.endc
.end
